reviews.evidence: Comprehensive terminal workspace with session branching/rewind/export, rich input and rendering, approvals, panels, model/effort switching, image flow, memory and LSP commands; README supplies a full command/key reference plus troubleshooting and known limits.
reviews.concern: The README has little non-promotional result evidence and only one brief when-to-use condition; many described host-harness capabilities are explicitly outside this bundle and were not credited.

reviews.evidence: Ships a draggable, zoomable session map preserving native fork relations, text-selected follow-ups and bidirectional session synchronization; two screenshots show the map and its native-Web entry, with clear storage/profile boundaries and test commands.
reviews.concern: The main README gives only a basic enter-and-browse path; detailed interaction, recovery and limitations are deferred to linked guides.

reviews.evidence: Provides structured DSH lessons, an automatically aggregated plugin marketplace, development guides, glossary and rankings; it documents local launch/data regeneration and a complete public-plugin submission path with sync timing and failure guidance.
reviews.concern: No concrete search/browse result is shown in the README, and it does not explain a substantive quality-verification or curation method beyond topic aggregation and off-topic filtering.

reviews.evidence: Broad CLI covers OAuth, meeting CRUD and invitees, contacts, recordings/transcripts/minutes, reports and asynchronous exports, in-meeting controls, diagnostics and feedback; the README is a comprehensive command reference with workflows, limits, security warnings and failure states.
reviews.concern: Despite extensive parameter and response-field documentation, it shows few complete real response payloads and states no concrete automated validation or test results.

reviews.evidence: End-to-end conversational image workflow spans generation, iterative editing, conversation/workspace persistence and a searchable gallery with preview/copy/download/delete across five provider families; prompts and multiple screenshots demonstrate generation, editing, settings and gallery states.
reviews.concern: Reliability evidence is limited to provider compatibility plus typecheck/test/package-check commands; no concrete failure behavior, limits, troubleshooting or recovery guidance is shown.

reviews.evidence: Comprehensive shipped stack aggregates, curates, safety/license-gates, deduplicates, evaluates and exports skills, trains/serves retrieval models and integrates multiple agent hosts; API examples include concrete input/output, benchmark tables show outcomes, and self-host/build/test/fallback boundaries are explicit.
reviews.concern: The full hosted catalog is closed and not downloadable, self-hosting currently demonstrates a 1,000-skill corpus, and the packaged Raven integration awaits an upstream slot.

reviews.evidence: A categorized, selectively annotated DSH guide combines verified-version framing, Web/source/SDK/plugin quick starts and detailed compatibility, maturity and risk notes across clients, plugins, integrations and development tools.
reviews.concern: It is a static catalog with no own search/browse interface, visible update cadence, reproducible verification methodology or concrete result demonstration; linked projects' capabilities were not credited.

reviews.evidence: Unusually comprehensive six-stage research system covers literature ingestion/wiki, idea generation and review, GPU experiments, collaborative LaTeX writing and citation/fact review through resumable human-gated Voyages; a video and read-only live instance demonstrate the platform, while checkpoints, budgets, verification, RBAC and deployment limits provide strong reliability evidence.
reviews.concern: The README is stronger on architecture and deployment than step-by-step researcher operations; desktop builds are unsigned and remain dependent on a separately deployed server.

reviews.evidence: Ships one focused capability: render model-authored HTML fragments as persistent interactive conversation cards, with wide mode and examples for simulations, charts, comparisons and UI mockups; a linked demo shows the interaction and the README states sandbox, CSP, size and client-fallback behavior.
reviews.concern: The tool is intentionally narrow, has only one demonstrated happy path, cannot send card interactions back into the conversation, and states no automated validation evidence.

reviews.evidence: Comprehensive Windows desktop workbench combines local Harness runtime, coding/chat, files and SCM, plugins/skills, task automation, mobile/SSH/QQ remote access, telemetry views and themes; many workflow screenshots plus transactional startup repair, rollback, release matrices, privacy controls and diagnostics demonstrate breadth and resilience.
reviews.concern: Most feature sections describe interactions rather than provide repeatable operational procedures, and the shipped client is restricted to Windows 10/11 x64.
